questions.answer: Data analyst salaries vary by experience, location, and industry, typically ranging from $50K to $90K annually in the US.Entry-level data analysts usually earn between $50,000 and $65,000 per year.Mid-level analysts with 3-5 years of experience can expect salaries from $65,000 to $80,000.Senior data analysts or those with specialized skills may earn upwards of $90,000 annually.Salaries vary significantly by location; for example, data analysts in San Francisco or New York often earn more due to higher living costs.Industry also impacts salary; data analysts in finance or tech sectors generally receive higher pay compared to non-profits or education.Freelance or contract data analysts might charge hourly rates ranging from $30 to $100 depending on expertise.
